scope.deployment: Vercel production plus local CLIProxy worker

nodes.label: Vercel daily collection cron
nodes.evidence: GET /api/collect is scheduled once daily at 30 14 * * *.

nodes.label: Authenticated collection route
nodes.evidence: The route requires exact CRON_SECRET auth and, on Vercel, skips workstyle and profile LLM derivations.
nodes.notes: No distributed lease prevents duplicate cron delivery from repeating Blob/source operations.

nodes.label: Two-date deterministic collection
nodes.evidence: The production handler collects yesterday and today, builds deterministic fallbacks when LLM is disabled, and stores user-scoped summaries.

nodes.label: Hard Vercel LLM block
nodes.evidence: isLlmDisabled returns true whenever VERCEL is present before fetch; the static UI also defaults missing capability flags to read-only.

nodes.label: GitHub source API
nodes.evidence: Per date, collection performs one /user call and at most five commit-search pages.

nodes.label: Slack source API
nodes.evidence: Collection reads configured channels and caps each history result at 200 messages.

nodes.label: ClickHouse prompt API
nodes.evidence: Authenticated SQL queries cap daily prompts at 200 and rolling-window prompts at 4000.

nodes.label: Vercel Blob operations
nodes.evidence: Production collection and reads use authenticated Vercel Blob get, put, list, and delete operations.
nodes.notes: No operation budget, abort timeout, or usage telemetry is proven in repository code.

nodes.label: Local scheduled enrichment
nodes.evidence: The script explicitly opts into CLIProxy enrichment for yesterday and today and never enables resume hooks.

nodes.label: Default collection-only local batch
nodes.evidence: runDailyBatch passes allowLlm only when options.allowLlm is exactly true; all ordinary and event-driven callers remain deterministic.

nodes.label: Explicit CLIProxy enrichment batch
nodes.evidence: Only the explicit --allow-llm CLI flag passes allowLlm=true into the daily batch; resume hooks are not registered.

nodes.label: Five-second debounced local event trigger
nodes.evidence: A commit, Slack, or session event may schedule one batch after five seconds, but it passes only userId and emitGranularEvents=false, so the batch remains allowLlm=false.

nodes.label: Input-fingerprinted daily cache
nodes.evidence: The cache key and entry validate user, model, schema, and exact normalized input hash before enrichment.
nodes.notes: One legitimate miss can invoke one combined summary/story request.

nodes.label: Combined summary and story LLM
nodes.evidence: One structured response returns daily summary fields and up to three project stories; the separate day-story call is no longer used by batch.mjs.

nodes.label: Local weekly profile refresh
nodes.evidence: refresh-profiles runs locally; profile export executes only for analyses whose seven-day LLM result was refreshed.

nodes.label: Seven-day workstyle freshness gate
nodes.evidence: LLM workstyle extraction runs only when prior llmGeneratedAt is absent or older than seven days.

nodes.label: Workstyle area LLM
nodes.evidence: At most five top areas plus one arealess group are extracted locally through the gateway.

nodes.label: Workstyle synthesis LLM
nodes.evidence: One local gateway call synthesizes up to 40 judgments.

nodes.label: Profile handover LLM
nodes.evidence: One handover request runs only for locally refreshed workstyle analyses.

nodes.label: Explicit local resume actions
nodes.evidence: Static production defaults to read-only; only local Vite or a server-injected, verified CLIProxy capability exposes chat and explicit draft generation.

nodes.label: Explicit resume LLM family
nodes.evidence: Bootstrap, extraction, draft, bridge, and reconstruction calls all delegate to the local central gateway and require explicit local actions.
nodes.notes: Full reconstruction still has an N+1 local call shape where N is the uncapped historical worklog count.

nodes.label: Explicit local resume agent
nodes.evidence: Agent init creates state without an LLM call; only message and revise actions enter the loop, and resume context is read with the session owner's userId.

nodes.label: Bounded local agent LLM
nodes.evidence: An explicit agent message can make at most three gateway calls with 4,000 output tokens each.

nodes.label: Opt-in embedding quality CLI
nodes.evidence: Embedding scoring is separately opt-in and is not called by normal batch, profile, or UI paths.

nodes.label: Direct embeddings API
nodes.evidence: Explicit local quality scoring posts sequential batches of at most 256 items to a separately configured endpoint; the Vercel guard returns before fetch.
nodes.notes: Total item count, per-text length, timeout, and telemetry remain unbounded locally.

nodes.label: Dormant legacy day-story LLM
nodes.evidence: The helper remains for compatibility tests, but batch.mjs no longer imports or calls summarizeDayStories.

nodes.label: Dormant legacy resume LLM family
nodes.evidence: Legacy recluster, decision, bullet, query-analysis, strength, and axes helpers delegate to the gateway but have no live production root.

nodes.label: Local-only central LLM gateway
nodes.evidence: The gateway discovers the local CLIProxy, permanently rejects api.openai.com, and enforces timeout, output caps, process caps, and telemetry; Vercel is rejected before fetch.
nodes.notes: The 100-call ceiling is process-local and is not a durable monetary budget.
